name: TIC 167009956

text.card: A red giant 1,421 parsecs away, 22 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded by TESS, give 0.93 solar masses and 22.2 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,276 K at its surface.
